name: student-management-system
description: StudentHub - MERN student management system (backend + frontend)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n db,api,web -c green,blue,magenta "npm run db:local --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
